references.text: The warning against following the customs of Egypt and Canaan, which sets the context for the abominations mentioned in verse 30.
The command to keep the Lord's laws and statutes and not do any of these abominations.
The instruction to keep all the Lord's statutes and laws and follow them.
A warning against following the customs of the nations that the Lord drives out, because they did all these things.
An exhortation to keep the Lord's commands without adding to or taking away from them.
A warning against following the abominable customs of the Gentile peoples and serving the Lord in their way.
Ezekiel describes the same abominations and the necessity of keeping the Lord's statutes.
Refers to the same sexual sins described as abominations in Leviticus 18.
Peter warns against living like the Gentiles in immorality and lust, which corresponds with the abominations in the Mosaic Law.
